package streamidentity_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	events "example.com/streamidentity/gen/events"
	hc "example.com/streamidentity/gen/http/events/client"
	hs "example.com/streamidentity/gen/http/events/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	implementation struct{}
	audit          struct {
		t      *testing.T
		server bool
	}
)

func TestServerAndClientStreamingAccessors(t *testing.T) {
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	endpoints := events.NewEndpoints(implementation{}, audit{t, true})
	hs.Mount(mux, hs.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	server := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer server.Close()
	transport := hc.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "http://"), server.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	client := events.NewClient(transport.Watch(), transport.WatchStream(), audit{t, false})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	stream, err := client.WatchStream(ctx, &events.WatchPayload{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() {
		require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
	}()
	for _, recv := range []func() (*events.Chunk, error){stream.Recv, func() (*events.Chunk, error) {
		return stream.RecvWithContext(ctx)
	}} {
		value, err := recv()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, "client", value.Value)
	}
	_, err = stream.Recv()
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
}

func (implementation) Watch(ctx context.Context, _ *events.WatchPayload, s events.WatchServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	for _, send := range []func(*events.Chunk) error{s.Send, func(c *events.Chunk) error {
		return s.SendWithContext(ctx, c)
	}} {
		if err := send(&events.Chunk{Value: "original"}); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return nil, s.Close()
}
func (a audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *events.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	if a.server {
		value := i.ServerStreamingResult()
		if value.Value() != "original" {
			a.t.Errorf("server accessor got %q", value.Value())
		}
		value.SetValue("server")
		return next(ctx, i.RawPayload())
	}
	res, err := next(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return res, err
	}
	value := i.ClientStreamingResult(res)
	require.Equal(a.t, "server", value.Value())
	value.SetValue("client")
	return res, nil
}
